잠언 18:1.content: Through desire a man, having separated himself, seeketh and intermeddleth with all wisdom.

잠언 18:2.content: A fool hath no delight in understanding, but that his heart may discover itself.

잠언 18:3.content: When the wicked cometh, then cometh also contempt, and with ignominy reproach.

잠언 18:4.content: The words of a man’s mouth are as deep waters, and the wellspring of wisdom as a flowing brook.

잠언 18:5.content: It is not good to accept the person of the wicked, to overthrow the righteous in judgment.

잠언 18:6.content: A fool’s lips enter into contention, and his mouth calleth for strokes.

잠언 18:7.content: A fool’s mouth is his destruction, and his lips are the snare of his soul.

잠언 18:8.content: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.

잠언 18:9.content: He also that is slothful in his work is brother to him that is a great waster.

잠언 18:10.content: The name of the Lord is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.

잠언 18:11.content: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, and as an high wall in his own conceit.

잠언 18:12.content: Before destruction the heart of man is haughty, and before honour is humility.

잠언 18:13.content: He that answereth a matter before he heareth it, it is folly and shame unto him.

잠언 18:14.content: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity; but a wounded spirit who can bear?

잠언 18:15.content: The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge; and the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge.

잠언 18:16.content: A man’s gift maketh room for him, and bringeth him before great men.

잠언 18:17.content: He that is first in his own cause seemeth just; but his neighbour cometh and searcheth him.

잠언 18:18.content: The lot causeth contentions to cease, and parteth between the mighty.

잠언 18:19.content: A brother offended is harder to be won than a strong city: and their contentions are like the bars of a castle.

잠언 18:20.content: A man’s belly shall be satisfied with the fruit of his mouth; and with the increase of his lips shall he be filled.

잠언 18:21.content: Death and life are in the power of the tongue: and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.

잠언 18:22.content: Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing, and obtaineth favour of the Lord.

잠언 18:23.content: The poor useth intreaties; but the rich answereth roughly.

잠언 18:24.content: A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.
